scope: Development observations, distinct from final validation

iterations.issue: The first lidar site was inside the mounting column and returned self geometry; scan matching incorrectly held the map pose near zero while the physical base moved.
iterations.correction: Mounted the sensor forward of the column and used a 270-degree front field of view with the mast in the blind sector. MuJoCo rays still test actual physical geometry.

iterations.issue: A shoulder support bar at the shoulder pivot intersected the moving upper-arm shell.
iterations.outcome: The arm could not reach the cube; the contact gate refused pickup.
iterations.correction: Moved the rear column/support above the shoulder and retained collision checking. Added a fixed visual bearing neck to connect the support to the fixed mounting flange.

final_evidence: validation.json contains three successful final-geometry cases. video_trial.json records the final full-physics video episode.
